Phase 58a (impl-only fix) @ c75d52f on phase/cockpit-session-lifecycle (PR #42). Doc: docs/phases/watcher-sigterm-test-event-mode.md.

What: PR #42 CI (ubuntu, run 34984321449) failed TestSigterm::test_sigterm_removes_pidfile_and_frees_lock — it asserted 'Watcher stopped.', which only the poll loop logs. CI installs .[event] (watchdog), and watcher_events.watch_with_events swallows KeyboardInterrupt silently. The on-submit gate runs in .venv without watchdog, so only poll mode was exercised. Where: tests/test_watcher_lock.py — log-line assertion removed; exit code 0, pidfile removed and lock free are still asserted (the actual contract). No product code changed.

Verification: reproduced the CI failure in a scratch venv with watchdog (uv venv + pip install -e '.[event]' pytest): 1 failed / 15 passed before, 16 passed after. Project .venv (no watchdog): 16 passed. Full suite: see gate entry. CI on PR #42 re-runs on push.

Gap worth noting: the gate environment lacks watchdog, so event-mode paths are only covered by CI.

GATE: PASS | scope skipped | plan-doc ok | tests ok (1995 passed, 5 skipped, 6m16s)

not checked — scope: no implementation boundary recorded (plan approved before 3.2.0, or a legacy cycle) — scope not enforced

Approved c75d52f. The diff removes only the backend-specific log assertion and preserves exit-code, pidfile-removal and lock-release checks. Verified that watcher_events.watch_with_events catches KeyboardInterrupt and returns through observer cleanup without the poll-loop message. No product behavior changes; scope manually verified from the commit diff because the gate skipped scope enforcement for this impl-only cycle.

Accepted gate PASS at matching HEAD c75d52f: 1995 passed, 5 skipped. Accepted the lead's reported focused reproduction and passes with and without watchdog; no redundant test run. PR #42 Ubuntu CI rerun 34986531118 is still pending at review time, so its pass criterion remains for closeout. No blocking code findings.
